title: 第三章 魔女还是圣女第四章 手里捧着窝窝头菜里没有一滴油
slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 女人双手抓着木笼栅栏，身上被铁链左三圈右三圈地缠着，这会儿正低垂着脑袋，一头乌黑的长发，凌乱地披散下来，遮盖住大半张脸。
一身破烂的红色衣裙满是血迹，只能勉强盖住玲珑有致的身段。
但即便如此，光从轮廓和露出来的半张侧脸来看都能看得出来，这女人的长相，绝对不差。
只是，她那半张侧脸苍白如纸，嘴唇上没有一丝血色，看着一副随时都会断气的样子。
这时候，队伍最前方，一个身着黑色飞鱼服的中年男人大步上前。
江澜看着这人，回忆起来。
这人姓赵，是镇魔司的一个百户，也是王虎的顶头上司。
王虎也不知道什么时候钻过来，满脸谄媚道：
“百户大人。”
赵百户扫了眼甲字牢房内部，随即沉声开口道：
“此女乃是净土宗魔女沈清寒，一等钦犯！连续刺杀我大周三位二品封疆大吏，杀镇魔司阻拦死士百余人，手段狠辣，罪大恶极！”
啊这。
江澜微微挑眉。
二品大员，还杀了百多个镇魔司的人。
这姑娘行啊。
而且这净土宗……听着好像也不怎么邪恶的样子。
这女人，看着小身板不算壮实，风一吹就倒的样子，没想到居然这么猛。
赵百户说完，心有余悸地挥了挥手，示意手下把人押进大牢。
“这女魔头大闹江南，若非指挥使大人亲自出手，根本拿不下她！圣上御笔亲批，将她打入天牢最深处，秋后择日问斩！”
“哗啦啦！”
一堆镇魔司的人，七手八脚把人安排到最里面的牢房。
等关好牢门，赵百户才对王虎道：
“务必严加看管，但凡出现任何问题，我唯你是问！”
“是，是，小的知道！”王虎在一旁点头哈腰，连连答应。
等送走了赵百户后，他这才转过头来，看向江澜，满是横肉的脸上，立马换上另一副表情。
“小江啊，你来得正好。”
江澜看着他那副嘴脸，就知道这吊毛准没好事。
现在看来，果不其然。
“这女人以后归你看着，刚才大人也说了，出了问题，唯你是问。”
您问您远在异世界的母亲呢？
不是问你吗？
怎么还问上我了？
社会可真他x的险恶。
这就是领导的甩锅能力吗？
content_en:
The woman was holding on to the wooden cage fence with both hands, and her body was wrapped with iron chains three times on the left and three times on the right. At this moment, her head was lowered, and her long black hair was messy, covering most of her face.
The tattered red dress was covered in bloodstains and could only barely cover her slim and graceful figure.
But even so, just from the outline and half of the exposed face, it can be seen that this woman's appearance is definitely not bad.
However, the side of her face was as pale as paper, there was no trace of blood on her lips, and she looked like she might die at any moment.
At this time, at the front of the team, a middle-aged man wearing a black flying fish suit strode forward.
Jiang Lan looked at this man and recalled.
This man's surname was Zhao, a member of the Demon Suppressing Department, and Wang Hu's immediate boss.
Wang Hu didn't know when he came over and said with a flattering face:
"Master Baihu."
Zhao Baihu glanced inside the A-shaped cell, and then said in a deep voice:
"This woman is Shen Qinghan, the witch of the Pure Land Sect, a first-class imperial convict! She assassinated three of my second-grade border officials in succession, and killed more than a hundred people by killing the demon commander. Her methods were ruthless and the crime was extremely heinous!"
Ah this.
Jiang Lan raised his eyebrows slightly.
A second-grade officer, he also killed more than a hundred people from the Demon Suppression Division.
This girl can do it.
And this Pure Land Sect... doesn't sound very evil.
This woman looked like she was not very strong for her small body, and she looked like she would fall over when the wind blew. I didn't expect her to be so strong.
After Zhao Baihu finished speaking, he waved his hand with lingering fear, indicating to his men to take the person to the prison.
"This female devil is causing trouble in the south of the Yangtze River. If the commander had not personally taken action, she would not have been able to capture her! With the approval of the Holy Emperor, she will be thrown into the deepest part of the heavenly prison, and she will be executed on the day she chooses!"
"Yes!"
"Crash!"
A bunch of people from the Demon Suppression Division were busy arranging people into the innermost cells.
After closing the cell door, Zhao Baihu said to Wang Hu:
"Be sure to keep strict supervision. If any questions arise, you are the only one I will ask!"
"Yes, yes, I know!" Wang Hu nodded and bowed and agreed repeatedly.
After sending Zhao Baihu away, he turned around and looked at Jiang Lan. His face, which was full of anger, immediately put on another expression.
"Xiao Jiang, you came just in time."
Jiang Lan looked at his face and knew that there was definitely something wrong with him.
Now it seems that it is indeed true.
"This woman will be yours to look after from now on. As I said just now, if there is a problem, you are the only one to ask."
Jiang Lan: "?"
What about your mother who is far away in another world?
Didn't I ask you?
Why are you still asking me?
Society is really fucking sinister.
Is this the leader’s ability to shift blame?
